{{Top}}
'''Chowder''' was a type of [[Soup/Legends|soup]] that typically included meat<ref name="DaD">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}}</ref> or a meat substitute as a central ingredient. Chowders included [[Blood chowder]], [[Nyork chowder]],<ref name="DaD" /> and [[Tauntaun chowder]].<ref name="Scav">[[Scavenger Hunt (adventure)|''Scavenger Hunt'']]</ref>
